pages.text: With the Screen Controller you can power nearby $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/screen)screens$(/l). Using the 'Scan' button in the GUI you can connect to all screens in a 32x32x32 radius.$(br2)$(5)Infusing$() this machine will increase this range

pages.title: Scanning
pages.text: Place the controller within range, supply FE, and press Scan. Re-scan after adding, removing, or moving screens.

pages.title: Range
pages.text: The default scan area is 32x32x32 blocks around the controller. $(5)Infusing$() the controller increases this range.
